commission: TRY FOREVER heartbeat skill lights — bounded source-hardening review and durability correction only

selectedJars.why: P0 and primary-phone ownership are explicit exclusions; source-only improvements must not widen the lane.
The slice makes source/evidence claims while deterministic testing is blocked.
The hardening must remain a small semantic patch rather than a neighboring architecture.
The Actions-budget failure must change strategy rather than trigger blind retries.
Repository code changed and requires evidence-first code review before this worker slice may stop.

boundedPlan: Inspect the exact current source-hardening diff from the last reviewed source head rather than rereading the entire campaign as authority.
Review closed-world envelope parsing, repository-skill provenance shape, parser-to-scene contact preservation, regression source, and DOM selection semantics for logic/regression risk.
Preserve the Actions-budget blocker exactly; do not manually retry unchanged CI or infer TESTED.
Preserve P0/primary-phone/Phone Hands/Nightcore/Pocket TTS/Chromium/Context Organs as untouched surfaces.
Persist any review/process defect and a fresh completion-review receipt; do not merge or claim runtime capability.

antagonism.risk: Closed-world v1 parsing could be mistaken for generic forward compatibility.
antagonism.answer: Unknown members are intentionally rejected only inside schema heartbeat-skill-lights.v1; future fields require a schema/contract change rather than silent acceptance.

antagonism.risk: A syntactically valid repository_skill path could be narrated as proving the skill exists.
antagonism.answer: Policy and doctrine explicitly state path-shape validation is not repository-existence proof; GitHub discovery/readback remains the evidence source.

antagonism.risk: Parser-to-scene composition could become a stealth runtime controller.
antagonism.answer: The overload is pure and non-rendering, takes only parser Result + last-good Frame, and owns no OperatorState, receiver, transport, phone, or P0 surface.

antagonism.risk: Accessibility semantics could overstate expansion behavior.
antagonism.answer: The always-present shared detail region now uses persistent selection via aria-pressed instead of aria-expanded.

antagonism.risk: Source regressions could be laundered into passing tests.
antagonism.answer: Current GitHub Actions jobs execute zero steps due the Actions-budget boundary; TESTED remains NO/BLOCKED_UNKNOWN.

processObservation.finding: The first source-hardening mutations in this worker slice occurred before this fresh plan-review receipt was persisted.
processObservation.effectOnCapabilityClaims: No promotion is allowed; source readback remains implementation evidence only.
processObservation.remediation: This receipt gates all subsequent mutations in this slice; the defect must also be preserved in the completion review rather than erased.

directiveScope: Review/durability correction of the existing bounded source-hardening slice only. No new phone/P0/runtime architecture, deployment, merge, or capability promotion is authorized.
